title: Carbon Atom Model (No AMS)
author: DaDokk_
description:
## _**Carbon Atom Model**_ ⚛

Model of a carbon atom with accurate number of electrons, protons and neutrons. The model doesn't support AMS so you have to color it yourself. You can also choose which nucleons will be protons and neutrons. I hope you like it. :)

atom carbon carbonatom chemistry model decoration

storage.note: 3MF files are stored as .3mf.xz to stay under GitHub's 100MB limit. Decompress with `xz -d -k <file>` before use; SHA-256 is computed on the compressed file.
